description:
Intent i038 (SNAPSHOT=s09, BRANCH=tasklet-napi-softirq-lock) complete. Two findings written to /mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/10_cluster/C7/agent-state/findings/i038.json, both line-verified in snapshots/s09 with grep/sed evidence:

FINDING 1 (medium): drivers/net/ethernet/freescale/fs_enet/fs_enet-main.c:691-709 — fs_enet_close (.ndo_stop at 835) takes plain spin_lock(&fep->tx_lock) at 702 nested in spin_lock_irqsave(&fep->lock) at 701 (IRQs disabled, bottom halves NOT), while NAPI poll fs_enet_napi (def 89, netif_napi_add_weight 971; scheduled from hardirq fs_enet_interrupt via request_irq:670 -> napi_schedule_prep:322 -> __napi_schedule:331) takes the SAME tx_lock with plain spin_lock at 101 in NET_RX softirq. Zero spin_lock_bh in the file; napi_disable at 697 narrows the window but free_irq only happens at 709 after the lock section, so the still-registered shared IRQ can schedule a new NAPI poll during the 701-705 section. Softirq spins forever against a preempted process holder — the tasklet/NAPI analogue of the ks7010 seed mechanism.

FINDING 2 (low): drivers/net/ethernet/altera/altera_tse_main.c:1002-1008 — tse_shutdown (.ndo_stop at 1027) takes plain spin_lock(&priv->tx_lock) at 1005 while NAPI poll tse_poll (netif_napi_add 1382, scheduled from hardirq altera_isr at 521/526, request_irq 924/933) -> tse_tx_complete:482 takes the same lock plainly at 435; the only spin_lock_bh in the file is the xmit site at 551, proving the driver knows the lock needs BH disable. Window narrowed by napi_disable (991) and free_irq (1000-1001) before the plain acquisition, hence low confidence; the verified defect is the missing-BH lock-discipline violation.

Also classified: fs_enet_start_xmit:487 and tse_xmit:551 as safe/out-of-scope (xmit branch), and mwl8k tasklet tx_lock plus the qtnfmac trans.c resp_lock / cw1200 wsm.c / cassini.c leads from the prior s09 xmit pass (fact f009) left unresolved. Static source analysis only (no .config for builds/lockdep); whole-tree tasklet/NAPI callback enumeration not completed before the finalize directive — limitations recorded in the artifact.
